reviewStatus: model-assisted opt-in preview accepted; human and complete family review pending

sources.name: march-w
sources.scope: Opt-in Union A W four-sample contact/passing preview; exact historical Gettysburg v9 only.
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh separate model-assisted native image inspection. Manual pelvis X and row-shared grounded-sole Y uncertain by approximately +/-8 native pixels; cap tops +/-3px, No anatomical or historical certification.
limitations: Separate model-assisted all-cell review supports an opt-in native W march preview; this is not independent human, anatomical or historical certification.
Opposite contact-leg chains are readable. Passing support identity remains partly occluded; chronology is a proposed contact/passing sequence for playback review, not a certified gait.
Native RGBA pixels are copied unchanged. Low-alpha RGB remnants are retained; zero diagnostic bright-blue pixels at alpha>=8 does not establish exhaustive fringe absence.
Manual pelvis X and row-shared grounded-sole Y are approximate; one335px source reference applies to all four frames, without per-frame size correction.
Image generation did not precisely preserve requested layout translations. Every final native cell was reviewed and measured afresh; no percent-transformation or unchanged-untargeted-pixels claim.
Minimum solid alpha64 padding is78px; whole weapons and boots remain inside each627px cell.
Complete drill, melee, casualties, recoil/settling, true bearers, all other missing views and full family/default approval remain unfinished.
Alpha1-only residual pixels sometimes approach a cell edge. Alpha8/64 margins are safe; this is not a claim of perfectly empty transparent borders.

sources.name: actions-w
sources.scope: Opt-in Union A W stationary actions; exact historical Gettysburg v9 only.
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh separate model-assisted native image inspection. Manual pelvis X and row-shared grounded-sole Y uncertain by approximately +/-8 native pixels; cap tops +/-3px, actual tube mouth +/-5px. No anatomical or historical certification.
limitations: Separate model-assisted all-cell review supports an opt-in native W preview; this is not independent human, anatomical or historical certification.
Native RGBA pixels are copied unchanged. Low-alpha RGB remnants are preserved; the blue diagnostic is not an exhaustive fringe detector.
Roots and cap-to-sole spans are approximate manual measurements; one shared source reference is used across phases, not an action-dependent size correction.
One held firing pose and two representative loading states do not establish recoil, settling or a complete verified period drill.
The stock/cheek/support/trigger silhouette is readable. Hidden bore/socket/grip and detailed finger relationships remain unverified.
Other missing directions and identities, melee, casualties, recoil, true bearers and complete family/default approval remain unfinished.
Firing bore mouth is approximately (151,201), distinct from bayonet tip (65,199); weapon projects screen-left near horizontal.
Minimum solid alpha64 padding is30px. Requested layout edits did not precisely preserve untargeted pixels; final full sheet was reviewed again.
Alpha1-only residual pixels sometimes approach a cell edge. Alpha8/64 margins are safe; this is not a claim of perfectly empty transparent borders.
